scientific_rationale: Activating the registered L036 local N/C patch on node single_b011_final_030 (template F_b011_s030_native) with the supplied execution contract unchanged. Direct geometry support is the frozen local subset atom_slots [6,8,13,22]; context neighbors 6 and 13 are directly constrained by the enabled geometry terms, and only points outside atom_slots lack direct geometry loss. Typed sites are slot 8 (C) and slot 22 (N); only typed_slots carry the type loss, so with type weight 0.3 the N/C identity at slots 8 and 22 is a measured outcome, not an operation enforced by the geometry-only reward. The enabled orientation term (weight 0.15) uses the single supported anchor A:VAL:116:N with outward vector [0.132,-0.224,0.966] and teacher_match_strength 0.9511 at slot 22, together with both local heavy-atom neighbors 6 and 13; this is a directional donor-geometry proxy, not a hydrogen-bond energy. The generated N decoder channel is treated as generic N until final chemical-role checks; the source distinction between eligible pyridine-type aromatic N and excluded pyrrole [nH]/amide N is preserved, and the role term, if enabled, would only softly prefer the selected N's neutral-charge and mapped aromatic-neighbor decoder probabilities without freezing the graph. Geometry uses distinct spatial assignments frozen within a derivative, never generated atom indices copied from the teacher. Gradients act only on current coordinates through real coordinate and atomic-decoder Jacobians; affinity is not differentiated, discrete labels are not overridden, the new graph is not fixed, and no SMC is introduced. Component normalization is part of the optimizer, not a single global potential with constant mixture weights. Expected observable changes: the endpoint and half terms should pull the selected local coordinates toward the frozen native/half geometry within the dose limits (max_atom_step 0.15 A, max_cumulative_rms 6.0 A, native_rms_ratio 0.33), the orientation term should bias the slot-22 N outward vector toward the A:VAL:116:N donor direction, and the type term should raise decoder N/C log probabilities at slots 8 and 22. Final affinity is primary; validity, failure, strain and actual local N/C response must be reported. The prior R01-R05 history on this patch (local_geometry, add_decoder_NC, stronger_decoder_NC, r13_counterfactual) never exceeded the R13_reference incumbent 8.378, and R02/R04 were rolled back, so this is activated only as a conditional local probe, not as a demonstrated affinity gain.
